---
title: "World café"
---

Four tables, about 15 minutes each. Hosts stay at their table; groups rotate. Add your answers to the Padlet from your phone: scan the QR code on the table or use the links in the table.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import yaml, io, html
from pathlib import Path
import qrcode, qrcode.image.svg

v = yaml.safe_load(Path("_variables.yml").read_text())

tables = [
    ("Data", "#1f77b4", v["padlet_data"],
     "The weirdest or messiest dataset you've worked with.",
     "Satellite imagery with cloud cover over every scene; GPS traces with gaps; geotagged social media posts; admin boundaries that change every census; surveys or social statistics with inconsistent coding.",
     "Word cloud of dataset types, plus a 'messiest' ranking."),
    ("Place", "#2ca02c", v["padlet_place"],
     "A place your research has taken you, physically or digitally. More than one is welcome!",
     "Fieldwork in Beirut; flood maps of Karachi seen from space; mobility data across Ukraine; Liverpool neighbourhoods on Street View.",
     "Pins on a world map."),
    ("Method", "#d62728", v["padlet_method"],
     "A method you wish you knew, and one you could teach.",
     "Causal inference (difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity); spatial econometrics; sensitivity analysis; geospatial machine learning; remote sensing classification; network analysis.",
     "Two columns, 'want' and 'teach', to show matches."),
    ("Problem", "#9467bd", v["padlet_problem"],
     "The question you'd work on with unlimited time and money, in 5 words max.",
     "\"Where do displaced people go?\" · \"Can satellites measure poverty?\" · \"Who suffers most from heat?\"",
     "A board of short questions, upvoted at the end."),
]

def qr_svg(url):
    img = qrcode.make(url, image_factory=qrcode.image.svg.SvgPathImage, box_size=10, border=1)
    buf = io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf)
    s = buf.getvalue().decode()
    return s[s.find("<svg"):].replace("<svg", '<svg class="qr"', 1)

out = ['<table class="cafe"><thead><tr><th>Table</th><th>Prompt</th><th>Examples</th><th>On the Padlet</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>']
for name, c, url, prompt, eg, viz in tables:
    ready = "REPLACE" not in url
    link = f'<a class="btn-padlet" href="{html.escape(url)}" target="_blank">Padlet</a>' if ready else '<span class="soon">link soon</span>'
    out.append(f'<tr style="--c:{c}"><td class="tname">{name}</td><td class="tprompt">{html.escape(prompt)}</td>'
               f'<td class="teg">{html.escape(eg)}</td><td class="tviz">{html.escape(viz)}</td><td>{link}</td></tr>')
out.append("</tbody></table>")
if any("REPLACE" not in t[2] for t in tables):
    out.append('<h2>Scan to add to the Padlet</h2><div class="qrs">')
    for name, c, url, *_ in tables:
        if "REPLACE" not in url:
            out.append(f'<div class="qrbox" style="--c:{c}"><div class="tname">{name}</div>{qr_svg(url)}</div>')
    out.append("</div>")
print("\n".join(out))
```

## Table hosts

Keep the conversation going, make sure ideas land on the Padlet, and get ready to pitch your table's highlights (about 4 minutes) at 14:35.
